content.bridge_context: This chapter introduces a unique educational philosophy that prioritizes empathy and character-building over academic grades.

units.title: Understanding Empathy
units.explanation: Empathy is the ability to understand and share the feelings of another person by 'putting yourself in their shoes'.
units.dual_language_instruction: Discuss how it feels to have a broken arm or leg. / चर्चा करें कि हाथ या पैर टूटने पर कैसा महसूस होता है।

units.title: Inclusive Education
units.explanation: Miss Beam's school teaches students to appreciate the challenges faced by differently-abled people by making them live through those challenges for a day.
units.dual_language_instruction: Identify different 'days' in the school (Blind Day, Deaf Day, etc.). / स्कूल में अलग-अलग 'दिनों' (अंधा दिन, बहरा दिन आदि) की पहचान करें।
